en.joke: I'm not addicted to my phone, I just need to keep it charged to doomscroll through posts about digital detoxes.
en.explanation: It's funny because it highlights the absurd cycle of being addicted to content about addiction, using current internet slang.

people.name: Diana Johnson
people.extract: Dame Diana Ruth Johnson is a British politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Kingston upon Hull North since the 2005 general election. A member of the Labour Party, she has served as Minister of State in the Department for Health and Social Care since 2026.
highlights: MP for Kingston upon Hull North since 2005.
Minister of State, Health and Social Care since 2026.

people.name: Arthur II of Brittany
people.extract: Arthur II, of the House of Dreux, was Duke of Brittany from 1305 to his death. He was the first son of John II and Beatrice, daughter of Henry III of England and Eleanor of Provence.
highlights: Son of John II and Beatrice.

people.name: Davidson Black
people.extract: Davidson Black was a Canadian paleoanthropologist, best known for his naming of Sinanthropus pekinensis. He was Chairman of the Geological Survey of China and a Fellow of the Royal Society. He was known as 步達生 in China.
highlights: Chairman of Geological Survey of China.
